messages:
marco: quick sync on the routing rules editor UI before I ship the feature to beta. key pieces: rules list with drag-to-reorder, numeric priority, inline validation badges, and a right-hand preview simulator. can folks scan for UX/accessibility issues? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/PRIVATE-RULES-EDITOR

jin: overall looks solid. two quick asks: 1) make the drag affordance larger for touch (not just three dots). 2) show a numeric priority pill (step=10 spacing) so logs and analytics have stable values.

lea: validation copy needs to be clearer. current: "Conflict with higher rule". suggestion: "This rule is shadowed by a higher-priority rule and will never match. Try moving it below or narrow the conditions. Learn more." include a help link. also collapse multiple conflicts behind a single badge with an expand chevron.

otis: preview panel is very useful. suggestions: highlight which rule matched in the sample request, and show the eval trace (condition checks). example snippet: ```{
  "request":"POST /v1/items",
  "matched_rule":"rule-22",
  "why":"path prefix /v1 matched"
}``` don't block saves if preview errors; surface a non-blocking warning.

marco: good. question on reorder semantics: optimistic (UI-only until save) vs immediate backend apply. preference for optimistic so people can batch edits. previews should reflect tentative order.

jin: optimistic is fine. ensure the UI marks unsaved changes and that the numeric badges update live. keyboard reorder required: focus on row then Alt+Up/Alt+Down to move. add aria-live updates so screen readers announce the new order.

lea: accessibility nits: error badges need icon+color (not color-only). ensure contrast meets WCAG AA. also focus management: when opening preview, move focus to panel heading and support Esc to close and return focus to the invoking rule.

otis: auto-resolve idea: propose a one-click suggestion that reorders rules to eliminate simple conflicts (preview the proposed changes and require confirm). don't apply automatically.

preview-bot: staging preview run -> 200 OK. sample result: ```{
  "input":"GET /api/users?page=2",
  "matched_rule":"rule-30",
  "reason":"first-match path /api/users"
}```

marco: action items: jin - update figma with larger handles + numeric pills (10-step), otis - mock auto-resolve flow and confirm preview behavior, lea - draft validation copy + docs link + collapsed conflict UI, i'll set optimistic save behavior in product notes and add a short QA checklist.

jin: i'll also add a subtle insertion line and ghost while dragging.

lea: i'll include suggested remediation lines for each conflict (e.g., "Move below rule 30 or narrow path to /api/users/{id}").

otis: i'll build keyboard prototype and a11y test steps and post in the PR.

marco: thanks all 44d merging to beta after updates.
